rationale: CO-151 with RARC N362 on the 97112 line is an MUE units-exceeded denial. The chart note documents only 31 minutes of 97112, which under the CMS 8-minute rule supports 2 units, not the 5 billed — a units/keying error, not a genuine threshold dispute. Correcting the units and resubmitting resolves it; no MAI value is needed since the documentation itself shows the billed units were wrong.
